'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*[[2024 Fox Hill Supercross race crash]]
**A car veers off the track during the international Fox Hill Supercross [[Motorsport|motor race]] in [[Diyatalawa]], [[Sri Lanka]], and crashes into a group of spectators, killing seven people and injuring 21 others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-68869318 (BBC News)]
*Nine people are killed after a vehicle collided with another vehicle in [[Jhalawar District]], [[India]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20240421/2b1ef3f572f9415db5f5b6200201f08b/c.html (Xinhua)]
